thread:
alex: Heads-up — planning to flip the feature flag `feature_x_v2` next Tue 09:00 PST (17:00 UTC). Need someone to execute the toggle, someone to run smoke, and a rollback plan. Default will be OFF.
marta: Can we pick a timezone window that covers EU afternoon? 17:00 UTC is fine for me. Are we doing a ramp or full-on? :eyes:
derek: I can deploy and flip the flag. Prefer to do an internal-only 0->on first (internal tenants), then 5% ramp for 30m, then widen.
lina: I'll own smoke. Can you add the smoke checklist to the ticket so I can follow it?
alex: Added checklist to the ticket — copy here for quick reference:
```
Smoke checklist for feature_x_v2:
- run `curl -sS https://staging.redwood/api/health | jq .` (service healthy)
- verify per-route latency < 200ms (dashboard: /dash/feature-x-latency)
- sample 50 requests through the new code path, verify responses match goldset
- check error budget + SLOs, alert if 5xx rate > 0.5% or p50 latency delta > 50ms
- run `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/flags/toggle -d '{"flag":"feature_x_v2","state":"on","scope":"internal"}'` to flip
- rollback: `.../flags/toggle -d '{"state":"off"}'` and pin previous config
```
marta: Can we make the default scope `internal` and require explicit `widen` action for public? Safer.
derek: Agree. Plan: 09:00 PST: flip internal -> observe 20m. 09:20 PST: 5% ramp across US/EU for 30m. 09:50 PST: decision point to widen to 100%. I'll run the toggles and post the commands/results in thread.
lina: I'll start smoke immediately after internal flip and post timestamps + a quick pass/fail. If anything flakey, I'll ask to rollback.
deploy-bot: Flag `feature_x_v2` scheduled: 2026-03-24T17:00:00Z -> internal scope. Requester: derek.
marta: Monitoring — can we create a temporary chart that surfaces tokenization latency + model RU (request units) per tenant? I'd like a per-tenant spike view for the first 30m.
derek: I'll create a canary monitor; alert channel #eng-oncall and page if p95 latency rises > 150ms or 5xx rate > 0.5%.
alex: Also please tag the deploy with `rollback-tag:fxv2-20260324` so ops can roll back that exact change if needed.
lina: Quick note: I ran a dev smoke this morning and saw a minor JSON schema mismatch on one route — I filed a tiny fix (PR #2319). Recommend merging that before flip or scope to exclude that route from canary.
derek: Good catch — I'll exclude the route from the initial 5% ramp.
marta: Who is the code owner on this? Need a CR + signoff recorded.
alex: Code owner is `@derek` and `@marta` is primary for rollout signoff. I will mark the ticket with signoff once smoke passes.
derek: I'll post deploy steps and exact `curl` outputs in here when I run. Also will run `kubectl rollout status` and post logs.
lina: FYI let's set an automated kill-switch: if p95>250ms for 5m, auto-toggle off. Is that possible with the current feature manager?
derek: The feature manager supports a webhook on threshold — I'll configure it and test in staging tomorrow.
alex: Final checklist before flip: (1) PR merged, (2) monitoring chart up, (3) kill-switch webhook configured, (4) smoke owner assigned (lina), (5) deployer assigned (derek). If all green we proceed.
marta: I'll be around for the decision point. If anything unexpected, we'll rollback. :thumbsup:
derek: Sounds good. I'll be on-call and will shout here when each step completes.
lina: Thanks — will be ready at 17:00 UTC to kick off smoke.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled in 30m: `feature_x_v2` activation window.
